EICMA 2026 • Here Are Some of the Serious and Obscure Brands That EICMA 2026 Had To Offer – Worth Knowing About
GTA 6 Gets Honored For the Worldwide Release By Everyone, Including the Aftermarket and CGI Realms
11 photos
Photo: Vossen / 1016Industries / Instagram
Everyone seems to be in love with Rockstar Games' new Grand Theft Auto VI, despite waiting for 13 years since the previous release came live. It seems that at least this time around “a bit” of waiting only enhanced the love affair.
This week has been riddled with bombshells, one after another. Early on, we found out that Amazon and Jeff Bezos decided at the last minute that Robert Pattinson – despite being 40 and already an established star in Hollywood – is the right choice for James Bond going forward; Anthropic just had its IPO on the same day that Rockstar unleashed GTA VI upon the world, and there’s also the ongoing 2026 LA Auto Show trying to compete for our attention.
The latter was shaping up to be a rather unimportant entry this year, with only the Rivian R2 and the all-new eighth-generation Hyundai Elantra making the headlines ahead of the press day. But then Chrysler also launched new goodies for the Pacifica, and Lamborghini dropped the teased surprise: its brand-new 907-hp Lamborghini Temerario Spyder was unveiled in Los Angeles, complete with a very cool vertical-hiding hardtop roof mechanism that actually enhances handling because it lowers the car’s center of gravity.
But the automotive world also decided to pay tribute to the GTA 6 (VI) release in its own way – people showed the loading screens ahead of the global release while aftermarket outlets prepared cool stuff with custom vehicles.
For example, Vossen was on point with a couple of rides – Miami recently embraced its Vice City alter ego in conjunction with the release of Grand Theft Auto VI by recreating the game’s iconic landmarks and art style. Here’s a Ram 2500 HD plastered with the murals and the Vice City sign, rocking a set of 26-inch Vossen GNX-06 in Miami White – while the entire truck is also wrapped in Xpel’s Stealth PPF.
Alongside Novitec, Vossen also showcased a Spofec Rolls-Royce Cullinan Series II Black Badge dubbed Overdose, equipped with the brand’s forged SP4 wheels and a lowering kit – and of course they also asked if it looks straight out of GTA VI. They weren’t the only ones, of course.
The great folks over at 1016Industries also decided to celebrate the release of Grand Theft Auto 6 with their Vision Lamborghini Temerario Widebody and a Huracan Performante – they showed both in the real world as well as renderings in Vice City!
